mapper.insert: insert into store_verify_growth_delivery(registration_id,member_id,missions_json,create_time,next_attempt_at) values(#{registrationId},#{memberId},#{missionsJson},now(),now()) on duplicate key update registration_id=values(registration_id)
mapper.select: select member_id, missions_json, create_time from store_verify_growth_delivery where registration_id=#{registrationId} and processed_at is null for update
select registration_id from store_verify_growth_delivery where processed_at is null and next_attempt_at <= now() order by next_attempt_at,registration_id limit 50
mapper.update: update store_verify_growth_delivery set processed_at=now(),last_error=null where registration_id=#{registrationId} and processed_at is null

update store_verify_growth_delivery set attempt_count=attempt_count+1,last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=date_add(now(), interval 1 minute) where registration_id=#{registrationId} and processed_at is null
